title: Relative Wasserstein Angle and the Problem of the $W_2$-Nearest Gaussian Distribution
abstract: arXiv:2601.22355v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding the distributional structure of high-dimensional datasets has become an important topic, yet direct visual characterization is difficult. In this work, we develop a geometric framework for characterizing the distributional structure of empirical datasets by quantifying their deviation from the Gaussian family under the geometry induced by optimal transport theory. Building on the cone structure of the relative translation invariant quadratic Wasserstein $(RW_2)$ space, we define two geometric quantities---the \emph{relative Wasserstein angle} and the \emph{orthogonal projection distance}---and show that they are well-defined because of the flat geometry of the filling cone between distributional rays. translated_title: 相对Wasserstein角与$W_2$-最近高斯分布问题
translated_abstract: 理解高维数据集的分布结构已成为一个重要课题，然而对其进行直接的视觉刻画十分困难。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个几何框架，通过在最优传输理论所诱导的几何下量化经验数据集与高斯族的偏差，来刻画经验数据集的分布结构。基于相对平移不变二次Wasserstein（$RW_2$）空间的锥结构，我们定义了两个几何量——*相对Wasserstein角*和*正交投影距离*——并证明由于分布射线之间填充锥的平坦几何，这两个量是良定义的。这一表述将度量与高斯族偏差的问题重新表述为向高斯锥做正交投影的问题，并揭示了常用的矩匹配高斯分布一般并非……
tldr: 本文基于最优传输几何定义了“相对Wasserstein角”和“正交投影距离”两个几何量，将刻画数据集偏离高斯族的程度转化为向高斯锥的正交投影问题，并表明常用的矩匹配高斯分布一般并非$W_2$意义下最近的高斯分布。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the relative Wasserstein angle and orthogonal projection distance under optimal transport geometry, recasting the deviation of a dataset from the Gaussian family as an orthogonal projection onto the Gaussian cone, and shows that the commonly used moment-matching Gaussian is generally not the $W_2$-nearest Gaussian.
